name: Noxious Glade
summary: North of Light's Hope Chapel, the Noxious Glade lies under a heavy veil of plague. The Scourge hold the hollow close to the Argent Dawn's watch.

sections.title: A Foul Foothold
sections.body:
At Light's Hope Chapel, the Argent Dawn keeps watch while a Scourge camp lies in the hills just north. Plague grips this hollow more fiercely than much of the surrounding land. Sickly green mist fills the air, and the soil has turned a bruised purple.

The undead have raised ziggurats here, along with a slaughterhouse where they assemble abominations. A plague cauldron continually sends pestilence into the air.

sections.title: Under the Dawn's Gaze
sections.body:
The glade lies close enough to Light's Hope Chapel to threaten travelers, couriers, and holy warriors who work from there. Scourge forces build monstrosities and brew toxins in the hollow, hidden from view by the natural ridge.

Climb the path unwary, and the Scourge may be waiting just ahead.

faq.q: Where is the Noxious Glade located?
aliases: how to get to noxious glade
faq.answer: The Noxious Glade lies in the hills immediately north of Light's Hope Chapel, in the eastern reaches of the Eastern Plaguelands.

faq.q: Why is the air and ground a different color here?
faq.answer: The glade is more heavily blighted than the rest of the Plaguelands. A working plague cauldron and nearby Scourge structures send toxins into the hollow, darkening the earth purple and filling the clearing with poisonous green haze.

faq.q: What Scourge structures are in the glade?
faq.answer: The glade holds several ziggurats, a plague cauldron, and a slaughterhouse where the Scourge assemble monstrous constructs such as abominations.

faq.q: Does the Argent Dawn know about this place?
faq.answer: Yes. The Argent Dawn knows of the glade, but its forces are stretched thin defending against Scourge attacks across the Plaguelands, leaving this nearby outpost dangerous.

angles.text: As a paladin, you can see how close Scourge blight has come to Light's Hope Chapel. Undead abominations and necromancers fill the glade.
As an undead champion, you may recognize these slaughterhouses and plague cauldrons as tools of the Lich King's rule. They show the fate that awaits those who do not break free.
